traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.summary: Move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.summary: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, reroll the die and use the new result.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.summary: Advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid falling from a tree.
traits.noEffect: Falling from a tree is not simulated separately from climb speed.

traits.name: Forest Friend
traits.summary: As an action, communicate simple ideas to beasts and plants within 30 feet for 10 minutes, once per long rest.
traits.noEffect: Beast and plant communication is not simulated.

traits.name: Fennveldt Lore
traits.summary: Treat Nature as proficient with double PB on checks about plants, beasts, or primal magic of forests and wetlands.

traits.name: Tunnel Network
traits.summary: In boggy terrain, dig simple tunnels at a quarter walking speed; while underground, know the direction to the nearest Aaldegar settlement.
traits.noEffect: Burrowing and settlement direction are not simulated.

traits.name: Bayou Studies
traits.summary: Ignore difficult terrain of swamps, marshes, or other wetlands; always add PB when checking dikes, drains, cellars, canals, and similar works.
traits.noEffect: Wetland terrain kinds and engineering checks are not simulated yet.

traits.name: Cross-Country Traveller
traits.summary: While traveling on foot for an hour or more, ignore difficult terrain.

traits.name: News of the Road
traits.summary: After 10 minutes exchanging news in a settlement or roadside camp, judge which local stories seem factual and which are rumor.

traits.name: Ashlung
traits.summary: Acclimated to extreme heat; smoke, ash, and sulfurous fumes do not harm you; advantage on saves against those effects; ignore difficult terrain from ash, cinders, and broken volcanic rock.
traits.noEffect: Heat, fumes, and volcanic terrain are not simulated yet.

traits.name: Landscape Memory
traits.summary: After 1 minute surveying an area you have visited before, learn what has changed since the last crossing.
traits.noEffect: Terrain change detection is not simulated.
